summary: Inter & Co, Inc. filed a Form 6-K pursuant to CVM Resolution No. 44, reporting that Squadra Investimentos notified it of crossing the 10% threshold of Class A Common Shares (32,806,391 shares, 10.07%). Squadra stated the acquisition is not aimed at changing control or management. This is a passive, regulatory disclosure of a significant stake, not an activist campaign, acquisition, or other special situation.
